value.text: We haven't built ICS on grand buildings or prestige. Our money and energy go into good teaching and real relationships with students. That's how our results stay strong while our fees stay modest.

value.title:
Some schools sell prestige. We focus
on results.
value.lead:
Our students consistently achieve academic outcomes that stand alongside, and in some areas exceed, the most expensive schools in the region. The difference?

You're not paying for sandstone buildings and branding. You're paying for teaching, care, and opportunity.
value.note: Not elite for the sake of it. Excellent because it matters.

image.alt: Primary students smiling at their desks in front of a world map

value.title: What accessible fees really mean.
value.text: Choosing an independent school shouldn't mean sacrificing family holidays, a second income, or your peace of mind. Our fee structure is deliberately accessible, and with a full K to 12 pathway you get one predictable, affordable schooling journey.
value.note: No navigating multiple schools. No surprise transitions.
list: Fees significantly lower than the region's premium private schools
Comparable, and often stronger, academic outcomes
One campus, one community, Kindergarten to Year 12

value.title:
A great place to teach and close
to home.
value.text: Join a close team and a supportive community where you’ll know your students by name and grow your career.

items.question: How is ICS different from other independent schools in the Illawarra?
items.answer: ICS has strong HSC results and a genuinely Christian culture, and its fees are well below most independent schools in the region. Every staff member is a Christian and every student is known by name.

items.question: Is ICS a good school academically?
items.answer: Yes. ICS is regularly ranked among the top [TBC: 3] Illawarra schools for HSC results [TBC: source]. Every Extension course is offered and several of our teachers are HSC markers.

items.question: Is ICS a private school?
items.answer: ICS is an independent, not-for-profit Christian school run by Illawarra Christian Education, an association of Christian parents.
